messages:
sam_ops: morning - seeing 404s hitting ts-sdk v0.23.0 from our prod worker. call: client.chat.summarize(...). started 2025-11-03 09:20 UTC. anyone else?

jessica_support: can you paste the stack + the exact SDK call? still on v0.23.0? :eyes: 

sam_ops: yep, pinned to 0.23.0. here's the code:

```ts
const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.RW_KEY });
const res = await client.chat.summarize({ model: 'redwood-xl', input: text });
```

Error: 404 Not Found - "route not found: /v1/chat/summarize"

kyle_dev: cc @jessica_support - quick guess: API route was renamed in server -> client mismatch. server expects `responses.summarize` route in newer API. v0.23 uses old path. do you have the SDK changelog pinned?

jessica_support: thanks. @sam_ops can you curl the raw API token + path that the SDK is calling? run with RW_DEBUG=1 too.

sam_ops: pulled debug + curl:

```
curl -X POST "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat/summarize" -H "Authorization: Bearer $RW_KEY" -d '{"input":"hi"}' -i
HTTP/1.1 404 Not Found
{"error":"route not found: /v1/chat/summarize"}
```

dev-rel: quick workaround: use the new client call or hit the compatible endpoint. Example with the interim route:

```ts
// workaround using raw HTTP until SDK bump
await fetch('https://api.redwood.ai/v1/responses/summarize', {method:'POST',headers:{'Authorization':`Bearer ${RW_KEY}`,'Content-Type':'application/json'},body:JSON.stringify({modelName:'redwood-xl',input:text})})
```

jessica_support: note param rename too: API now expects `modelName` not `model`. that will 400 if you call new route with old param.

sam_ops: confirmed workaround works. switching to direct fetch in prod for now. what's the plan for SDK patch?

kyle_dev: we cut v0.24.0-beta yesterday with renamed routes/params. scheduled stable v0.24.1 release in 2 hours. recommend upgrading. we'll also add a runtime compat shim in SDK to avoid 404s for a week.

infra-bot: deploy 2468 started for api-server (route-compat) - canary 5%.

jessica_support: thanks everyone. sam, once you upgrade or use shim please reply here so we can close the support ticket. tagging @dev-rel to follow up on docs + migration notes.

sam_ops: upgraded to 0.24.1 and verified: client.responses.summarize({modelName, input}) succeeds. closing.

kyle_dev: adding an ops blurb to release notes about param rename & temporary shim.

jessica_support: document link: https://docs.redwood.ai/migrations/sdk-v0.24#responses-rename :thumbsup:
